---
name: Improvement proposal
about: Propose a focused improvement or new integration
---

## Problem

Describe the use case and affected app/package.

## Proposed change

Explain the expected behavior and any alternatives considered.

## Validation and compatibility

Describe how the change could be tested. For detection changes, include legitimate cases that must keep working. For external feeds/services, include source and terms links. Note any schema, Redis format, API, or operational implications.
